mechanics.claim: The star's total damage scales further with distance traveled, from 0% to 150% (capped in practice at 146.6% due to a bug) of the minimum values, applied on top of the base+AP damage.
mechanics.quote: The '''total''' damage is increased by {{pp|type=distance traveled|key=%|0 to 150 for 7|800;950;1350;1650;1950;2250;2550}}.

mechanics.claim: Paddle Star!'s total damage will be increased for a maximum of 146.6% instead of the expected 150%, capping the maximum-distance damage bonus.
mechanics.quote: ''Paddle Star!'s'' total damage will be increased for a maximum of 146,6% instead of the expected 150%.{{bug}}

mechanics.claim: The recast redirects the star and resets its distance-based damage modifier, meaning the recast's damage bonus is recalculated from the recast point rather than continuing from the initial cast.
mechanics.quote: '''Zoe''' redirects the star in the target path, empowering it with increased speed and radius, and resetting its damage modifier on cast.

mechanics.claim: Both the initial cast and the recast count as separate ability activations for on-cast effects like Spellblade, so both can proc on-hit/on-cast item and rune effects.
mechanics.quote: Both casts count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{ai|More Sparkles!|Zoe}}, {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.

mechanics.claim: The recast has no cast time, unlike the initial cast which has a 0.25s cast time.
